##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 5 (Great Saxon Uprising) effects, generated by tools/gen_script_gsu.py
##########################################################################

# Title (duchy) scope, root = the ruler. A leader of the English rises in this duchy: he is given one of its counties, becomes independent,
# raises about 5,000 men and claims the duchy.
eir_gsu_launch_duchy_effect = {
	save_scope_as = eir_up_duchy
	clear_saved_scope = eir_up_county
	clear_saved_scope = eir_up_leader
	random_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
		limit = {
			tier = tier_county
			holder ?= { top_liege = root }
			NOT = { this = root.capital_county }
		}
		save_scope_as = eir_up_county
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:eir_up_county }
		root = {
			create_character = {
				location = scope:eir_up_county.title_province
				age = { 25 45 }
				gender_female_chance = 10
				culture = culture:anglo_saxon
				faith = scope:eir_up_county.faith
				random_traits = yes
				save_scope_as = eir_up_leader
			}
			create_title_and_vassal_change = {
				type = independency
				save_scope_as = eir_up_change
				add_claim_on_loss = no
			}
		}
		scope:eir_up_county = {
			change_title_holder = {
				holder = scope:eir_up_leader
				change = scope:eir_up_change
			}
		}
		scope:eir_up_leader = {
			becomes_independent = { change = scope:eir_up_change }
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:eir_up_change
		scope:eir_up_leader = {
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_gsu_player
				value = root
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = eir_gsu_duchy
				value = scope:eir_up_duchy
			}
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_saxon_rebel_modifier
				years = 8
			}
			add_pressed_claim = scope:eir_up_duchy
			spawn_army = {
				levies = 3200
				men_at_arms = {
					type = armored_footmen
					stacks = 8
				}
				men_at_arms = {
					type = light_footmen
					stacks = 6
				}
				men_at_arms = {
					type = bowmen
					stacks = 4
				}
				location = scope:eir_up_county.title_province
				origin = capital_province
				inheritable = no
				uses_supply = no
				name = eir_gsu_host_name
			}
			add_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
			start_war = {
				cb = claim_cb
				target = scope:eir_up_duchy.holder
				claimant = scope:eir_up_leader
				target_title = scope:eir_up_duchy
			}
			remove_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
		}
		root = {
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = eir_gsu_leaders
				target = scope:eir_up_leader
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = eir_gsu_total
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Character scope: the Uprising breaks out (one war for every duchy of England under foreign occupation).
eir_gsu_start_effect = {
	set_global_variable = eir_gsu_active
	set_global_variable = { name = eir_gsu_cooldown days = 18250 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = eir_gsu_done_1 }
		set_global_variable = eir_gsu_done_2
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = eir_gsu_done_1
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = eir_gsu_total
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = eir_gsu_resolved
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = eir_gsu_wins
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = eir_gsu_losses
		value = 0
	}
	clear_variable_list = eir_gsu_leaders
	title:k_england = {
		every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
			limit = {
				tier = tier_duchy
				eir_gsu_duchy_qualifies_trigger = yes
			}
			eir_gsu_launch_duchy_effect = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_event = { id = eir.0901 days = 90 }
	trigger_event = { id = eir.0902 days = 300 }
	trigger_event = { id = eir.0903 days = 600 }
	trigger_event = { id = eir.0915 days = 2300 }
}

# Character scope, expects scope:eir_up_duchy and scope:eir_up_leader: the rebels won this war.
eir_gsu_rebel_won_effect = {
	scope:eir_up_duchy = {
		every_de_jure_county = {
			limit = {
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						top_liege = root
						top_liege = scope:eir_up_leader
					}
				}
			}
			change_development_level = -1
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_ravaged_modifier
				years = 20
			}
			random = {
				chance = 35
				change_development_level = -1
			}
			random = {
				chance = 45
				set_county_culture = scope:eir_up_leader.culture
			}
			every_county_province = {
				eir_ravage_province_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = eir_gsu_losses
		add = 1
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = eir_gsu_resolved
		add = 1
	}
}

# Character scope, expects scope:eir_up_duchy: the rebels lost this war.
eir_gsu_rebel_lost_effect = {
	scope:eir_up_duchy = {
		every_de_jure_county = {
			limit = { holder ?= { top_liege = root } }
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_liberated_county_modifier
				years = 12
			}
		}
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = eir_gsu_wins
		add = 1
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = eir_gsu_resolved
		add = 1
	}
}

# Character scope: when every war is settled the Uprising ends.
eir_gsu_check_end_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = eir_gsu_active
			var:eir_gsu_resolved >= var:eir_gsu_total
		}
		trigger_event = { id = eir.0914 days = 20 }
	}
}
